newsitem.title: FRANCE: Boeing merger must be checked - Rexrodt.
newsitem.headline: Boeing merger must be checked - Rexrodt.

text.p: German Economics Minister Guenther Rexrodt said on Monday the proposed merger of U.S. aerospace groups Boeing Co and McDonnell Douglas Corp had to be checked carefully to see if it would create a market-dominating position.
"It must be prevented in any case where it comes to the dictation of prices for airlines and consumers," Rexrodt said, according to the text of a speech to be delivered at the Paris airshow.
McDonnell Douglas would give Boeing a broad position in military aircraft, while already holding 60 percent of the market for commercial airliners.

The merger "will create a unique technology competence that gives Boeing the possibility to further expand its market position through strengthened cross-subsidies between civil and military sectors," he said after a meeting of the ministers of Airbus Industrie, Europe's commercial airliner consortium.
The merger and Boeing's recent contracts to become exclusive supplier to three U.S. airlines were being reviewed by the European Commission.

"Through exclusive contracts American airline companies will be bound to one provider and the American market will be blocked for Airbus," Rexrodt said. "These contracts document the great danger that goes out from the increasingly stronger market position of Boeing-MDD."
Rexrodt said the merger had to be checked carefully and all the parties involved should have the opportunity to express their positions.
